text:
lee: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning. During cert rollover we saw a concentrated retry spike in eu-west and a handful of TLS handshakes failing with SNI mismatch.

maria: yep — want a compact owner list and ETA. we'll feed this into the incident timeline.

sre_harper: i'll take the remediation for rollout consistency. plan: make the rotator perform a two-phase commit across regions (prepare/apply) so certs only flip once quorum is met. also add a propagation TTL metric. ETA: 10 business days. JIRA: NET-1810.

dan: i'll pick up the short-term LB tuning: lower max retry attempts and increase exponential backoff window for scheduled rollovers. implement as a feature flag so we only enable during maintenance windows. PR by Wed. JIRA: NET-1811.

nina: i'll own validation + synthetic checks. tasks: add SNI/cert-subject verification and a 1m cross-region latency probe that runs immediately post-rotate. hook into CI so bad rotations fail. ETA: 4 days. JIRA: NET-1812.

maria: i'll draft the comms for tenant owners + add a runbook snippet for on-call to flip the feature flag. ETA: 48h. OPS-946.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotator job scheduled: v3.0.1 -> v3.0.2 at 2025-02-12T04:00Z (dry-run at 2025-02-12T03:45Z).

sre_harper: monitoring note 97 alert to detect region retry-rate spike: expression: sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[5m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[5m])) > 0.04 for 8m -> page SRE.

dan: i found correlation with route churn events in bgp logs ~12s before retries. opening NET-1813 to investigate route convergence and session flaps.

nina: validation snippet i'll add to CI:
```
for r in eu-west us-east ap-south; do
  curl -sSI https://$r.app.internal/health -H "Host: app.example.com" --resolve app.example.com:443:10.2.3.4 | grep -i "subject:" || exit 1
done
```
This will run as part of post-rotate smoke checks.

lee: compact action table (owner, jira, task, ETA):
- sre_harper, NET-1810, two-phase cert rollout + TTL metric, 10d
- dan, NET-1811, LB retry-backoff feature flag, Wed EOD
- nina, NET-1812, post-rotate synthetics + CI gate, 4d
- maria, OPS-946, comms + runbook snippet, 48h
- ops (oncall), OPS-947, enable flag during next maint window, immediate

maria: uploaded runbook draft to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/internal/net/rotator-followup (internal). left checklist for oncall.

sre_harper: scheduling brief sync 30m tomorrow 14:30 UTC to confirm acceptance criteria and QA plan. invite sent.

lee: using this thread as canonical action tracker. please report PR links and any timeline changes here. :white_check_mark:
